content: 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata kemɨtinua
Hikɨ 'atahutarieka Tsemana 'ixɨarariyari 'aye'aku, yunaitɨ mepɨyuxeɨriekai yameteyurienike 'auxeikɨa.
Yapauka taheima mieme 'eka hepaɨ 'anetɨ kaniukuyani tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ yemietɨ, mɨkɨ yuariya kiita putahɨnixɨ memuwayetekaitsie.
Hikɨ tai hepaɨ 'anenetɨ puyuhekɨarixɨ yuxexuime wahetsie.
Yunaitɨ 'Iyari Mɨtiyupatakɨ meputihɨnixɨ, meta mepitsutɨa me'utiniutɨ hipame niukiyarikɨ, 'Iyari kemɨtiwapitɨakai memɨtiniunikɨ.
Hikɨ Kerutsareme mepɨtitekai huriyutsixi Kakaɨyari memayexeiya, yunaime nuiwarite watsata memɨ'ayumiemetetɨkai naitsarie muyuawitɨa.
Kepauka yuariya memu'eni yunaitɨ mepuyuxeɨri, mepɨyuxamuriekai yuxexuitɨ yuniukikɨ memɨwa'eniekaikɨ me'utiniukame.
Mepɨ'iyarixiekai meta mepɨhɨxiyakai mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «¿Neuxei, 'ikɨ yunaitɨ memutiniuka mekatekarereyutari?
¿Ketɨtɨri 'ikɨ tetewa'enie taxexuitɨ taniukikɨ meputiniuka ketemɨte'ununuiwaxɨ?
Parutiyatari, meriyatari, 'eramitatari, Metsuputamiya kiekatari, Kureyatsie, Kaparutsiyatsie, Punitutsie meta 'Atsiyatsie,
Pɨrikiyatsie, Pamɨpiriyatsie, 'Ekipitutsie, Riwiya 'aurie mukumatsie Tsirene temɨtama, xumatari memɨ'iwatatɨwe,
huriyutsixi, hipatɨ huriyutsixi memayuyeitɨa, kɨretatari, 'arawiyatari, tanaitɨ tepɨwa'enie taniukikɨ memutiniuka, Kakaɨyari kemɨtimariwe mekuxatame».
Yunaitɨ mekani'iyarixiekaitɨni, 'atsimekatemaitɨ ketɨtɨ mɨtiyɨanekai, yuxexuitɨ mɨpaɨ meteyɨkɨhɨawetɨ: «¿Ketɨtɨ 'ikɨ pɨtiyɨane?»
Hipatɨ mewananaimatɨ xeikɨa mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Winu makakakɨ xeikɨa mepuhuxa».
Pekuru yumɨireme wahɨxie kemɨtikuxatakai

Hikɨ Pekuru 'anukukeka tamamata heimana xewi wahamatɨa, karima kaniutaniuni, mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Neuxei huriyutsixi, yunaitɨ Kerutsareme xemɨtama, xeketenemaika ketɨtɨ mɨtiyɨane, hikɨ xekeneneu'eni kenemɨtayɨni.
'Ikɨ mepɨkatarɨwe xeme xemɨteku'eriwa hepaɨ, matsi puximeri 'akuxi 'etsiwa xeikɨa puxɨka.
'Ikɨtsɨ kanihɨkɨtɨni tita mɨtixatsiwakai, tixaxatame Kuheri ya'utainekaku:

content.text: »Mɨpaɨ paine Kakaɨyari: “Tukari 'aye'ayu kepauka mɨtaparirɨmeni mɨpaɨ pɨtiyɨni,
Nepɨwahɨxiyatsitɨani waheima muyuawitsie meta kwiepa 'inɨari nepɨtiyurieni,

content: »'Ixaheri teɨteriyari, 'ikɨ niuki xekene'enieka: Kakaɨyari xetsata pitahekɨataxɨ Ketsutsi natsaretitanaka mariwemekɨ tiyurienetɨ tɨrɨkaɨyemekɨ, wahɨxiyatsitɨatɨ meta 'inɨarikɨ tiyurienetɨ mɨkɨ hetsiemieme, Kakaɨyari kemɨtiuyuri xeme xekatenimaika.
'Ikɨ kaniyetuiyani yamɨraye'anikɨ Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ timaitɨ, matɨaripaitɨ, kaneiyenɨ'ani mɨyetuiyanikɨ, teɨteri 'axateyuruwamete xetewaruta'aitɨaka xekaniwiya, kuruxitsie xe'ikawieka xekanimieni.
Matsi Kakaɨyari kanenukuketɨani, 'ixɨnaka kemɨrehɨiyakai mɨkitɨ, mɨkɨ pɨkayɨwekai mɨkitɨ muyuhayewakɨ.
Rawiri mɨpaɨ paine hepaɨtsitana:
»Neuxei 'iwamarixi, 'aixɨa kani'aneni heitseriemekɨ mɨtixekuxaxatɨwanikɨ tatewari Rawiri hepaɨtsita, kaniumɨni meta tiukateukie, makateukietsie mana kaniukani tatsata hikɨ 'akuxi.

Tixaxatame pɨhɨkɨtɨkai meta katinimaikaitɨni kename Kakaɨyari 'ɨyɨhɨritɨa heitseriemekɨ mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ, xewitɨ Rawiri hetsie mɨyeyanikekai heitserie pɨpitɨarienikekai Kɨritsitutɨtɨ, pikayenikekai 'uwenieya mɨra'aitatsie.
Matɨaripaitɨ 'ixeiyatɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni, Kɨritsitu kemɨranukuke tikuxatatɨ, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:
Hikɨ Kakaɨyari Ketsutsi panukuketɨa, tame tanaitɨ temunenierixɨ tepɨhɨkɨ.
'Anutiwitɨkieka mariwetɨ patɨa, Kakaɨyari tserieta, kanitanaki'erieni tita 'ukiyarieya mɨtiyetuirienikekai, 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata hɨkɨtɨme. Mɨkɨ kaniutatuani hikɨ kexemɨte'ixeiya meta kexemɨte'i'enie.
Rawiri muyuawitsie pɨka'anutitɨa, matsi yaputayɨ:
»'Ayumieme heitseriemekɨ mɨpaɨ xeketenemaika yunaitɨ 'Ixaheri xemɨtama, kemɨ'ane xeme kuruxitsie xemukawi, Kakaɨyari Ti'aitame meta Kɨritsitu
peyeitɨa».
Kepauka 'ikɨ niuki memu'eni yunaitɨ yu'iyaritsie mepuhiweritɨarie, Pekuru meta hipame nɨ'ariekate mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: —'Iwamarixi, ¿keri teteyurieka?

Pekuru mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Xeketeneuhayewa 'axakexemɨteyurie, meta yuxexuitɨ xepɨka'ɨyarieni Ketsutsi Kɨritsitu hetsie, tita 'axaxemɨte'uyuri, xemɨteheuyehɨwiyarienikɨ, meta 'Iyari Mɨtiyupata xehexeiyatɨ xepakɨne.
'Ikɨ kemutayɨ xehetsie pɨmieme, xetɨriyama wahetsie meta yunaitɨ teewa kɨkamete, tatsɨari, mɨkɨ yunaitɨ Ti'aitame takakaɨyari mɨwaranayexeiya.
Hipame mɨireme niukikɨ kaniwawawiriekaitɨni mɨpaɨ tiwakɨhɨawetɨ: —Xekeneyutawikweitsitɨa hikɨ miemete 'axamemɨte'u'iyari watsata.
Yuri memɨte'erie memakuteitsie
Hikɨ mɨkɨ niukieya memutanaki'eri mekaniuka'ɨyarieni, mɨkɨ tukaritsie mepɨwarutinɨi teɨteri haika miriyari meyupaɨmetɨ.
Yamepɨ'ayumiemetetɨkai nɨ'ariekate kememɨte'ɨkitakai, meyuxewitɨ meyuparewietɨ paa metitaratɨ meta meyunenewietɨ.
Yunaitɨ yu'iyaritsie meheumamatɨ mekanakɨne, waɨkawa mamariwawemekɨ meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨteyuriekaikɨ nɨ'ariekate.
Yunaitɨ yuri memɨte'erie 'axeikɨa mekanikutekaitɨni yunaitɨ meyuxewitɨ, 'axeikɨa naime mepɨtehexeiyakai:
yukwie meta yupiinite mepɨtetuakai, mepɨtewayetuiriwakai yuxexuitɨ memɨteheuyehɨwa.
Tukarikɨ tukita meyukuxexeɨriwatɨ mepɨkatehayewakai. Paa kii meuti'uta mepɨtekwakai meyutemamawietɨ, meta 'aixɨa mete'u'iyaritɨ,
Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita 'aixɨa meputiyuanekai meta yunaitɨ teɨteri 'aixɨa mepɨteku'eriwakai wahepaɨtsita. Tukarikɨ Ti'aitame waxewiriyatɨ mɨkɨ pɨwaxeɨriekai memɨtawikweitsitɨariwakai.
